overview.html:
AI Interaction Guide

A comprehensive guide for using AI assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc.) to manage command center content. This enables rapid content updates, consistent data structures, and frictionless planning through conversational AI.

🤖 Quick Start

Simply tell the AI what you want to add or update. Example: "Add a storyline called 'User Analytics' to the 4eye campaign" - the AI will handle file locations, data structure, and bidirectional linking.

Documentation: /apps/command-center/src/docs/ADDING_CONTENT_GUIDE.md

customSections.title: ⚡ Quick Actions
customSections.html:
Common requests you can make to AI. Just say these naturally:

📖 Add Storyline
"Add a storyline called [name] to [campaign] about [description]"
🧭 Add Navigational Variable
"Add a navigational variable: [title] - [description] as a [type]"
📝 Create Wiki Page
"Create wiki documentation for [storyline] with goals about [topics]"
🎯 Add Goal
"Add a goal to [campaign/storyline]: [description]"
🔄 Update Status
"Update [item] status to [in-progress/completed/paused]"
🗂️ Add Custom Section
"Add a section to [storyline] wiki about [topic]"

customSections.title: 📖 Adding a Storyline
customSections.html:
Required Fields

{
  "id": "campaign-feature-name",      // kebab-case, prefix with campaign
  "name": "Feature Name",             // Display name
  "description": "Brief description", // 1-2 sentences
  "status": "not-started",            // not-started | in-progress | paused | quest-complete
  "priority": "P2",                   // P1 | P2 | P3
  "category": "business",             // business | personal
  "color": "#4ECDC4",                 // Match campaign color
  "icon": "Psychology",               // MUI icon name
  "campaignIds": ["4eye"]             // Which campaigns this belongs to
}
⚠️ Don't Forget: Add the storyline ID to the campaign's storylineIds array in campaigns.json!

customSections.title: 🧭 Adding a Navigational Variable
customSections.html:
Required Fields

{
  "id": "nav-descriptive-name",
  "title": "Short Title (5-7 words)",
  "description": "Detailed explanation of the insight or strategy",
  "type": "strategy"  // advantage | opportunity | strategy | insight
}
advantage
Something you have that others don't
opportunity
External factors to leverage
strategy
Intentional approach or tactic
insight
Key realization or learning

customSections.title: 📝 Creating Wiki Documentation
customSections.html:
Wiki File Structure

{
  "storylineId": "storyline-id",
  "lastUpdated": "2026-02-11",
  "overview": {
    "html": "<div>Rich HTML overview...</div>",
    "summary": "Plain text for cards/previews"
  },
  "goals": [
    {
      "id": "goal-1",
      "title": "Goal Title",
      "description": "What this achieves",
      "timeframe": "short",  // short | medium | long
      "status": "not-started",
      "linkedQuestIds": []
    }
  ],
  "customSections": [
    {
      "id": "section-1",
      "title": "Section Title",
      "html": "<div>Section content...</div>",
      "order": 1
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Optional notes"
}

File location: data/storylines/wiki/{storylineId}.json

customSections.title: ✅ Validation Checklist
customSections.html:
After making changes, AI should verify:

✓ JSON Syntax Valid
No trailing commas, proper escaping, valid structure
✓ IDs Unique
No duplicate IDs within the same file
✓ Bidirectional Links
Storyline ↔ Campaign references match
✓ Valid Enums
Status, priority, type values are valid options
✓ Color Consistency
Colors match campaign theme
✓ No Errors
Run get_errors on modified files

customSections.title: 💬 Request Templates
customSections.html:
Copy and adapt these phrases for common requests:

Add Storyline:
"Insert a storyline called '[Name]' under the [campaign] campaign. It's about [description]. Create a wiki page with goals for [goal topics]."
Add Navigational Variable:
"Add this as a navigational variable in the compass: [Title] - [Description]. It's a [strategy/insight/advantage/opportunity]."
Update Status:
"Update the [storyline/campaign name] status to [in-progress/completed/paused]."
Add Wiki Section:
"Add a section to the [storyline] wiki about [topic]. Include [specific content]."

customSections.title: 💡 Best Practices
customSections.html:
🎯 Be Specific About Campaign

Always mention which campaign the content belongs to. This ensures proper linking and color matching.

📋 Describe the Purpose

Include what the feature/concept is FOR. This helps AI write better descriptions and wiki content.

🔗 Mention Related Items

If the new content relates to existing storylines or campaigns, mention them for proper cross-referencing.

📝 Request Wiki If Needed

If you want detailed documentation, explicitly ask for a wiki page to be created with specific sections.
